description: Traditional Ashtakoot guna milan (out of 36) for marriage between two people, calculated with VedicDost's software from their birth details: all 8 kootas (Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, Nadi), Nadi/Bhakoot dosha and their classical cancellation (parihar), and a Manglik check for both. Use for "kundli milan", "guna milan", "are we compatible for marriage".

place.description: Birth place: an Indian city ("Satna") or "City, Country" anywhere ("London, United Kingdom")

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour local clock time (optional; without it Lagna and houses are skipped)

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); found from the place if left out
